nodes.description: Internal address state variable in Proxy holding the master copy implementation address; stored in slot 0 and used as the delegatecall target in the fallback function.
Constructor of Proxy that requires _masterCopy != address(0) and writes it into the masterCopy state variable.
Payable external fallback function; reads slot 0 and delegatecalls to masterCopy forwarding calldata, returning returndata.
Public function that deploys a new Proxy via new Proxy(masterCopy) and optionally performs a low-level call with the supplied data payload.
Pure view helper returning type(Proxy).runtimeCode used to verify deployed proxy bytecode.
Pure helper returning type(Proxy).creationCode for predicted address calculation.
Internal function building a salt from keccak256(initializer) and saltNonce and deploying the proxy deterministically with create2.
Public function that calls deployProxyWithNonce and then performs a low-level call into the new proxy with the initializer payload.
Public function that computes a callback-derived nonce, creates the proxy and then invokes the external IProxyCreationCallback callback.
External helper that deploys the proxy to compute its address and then always reverts with the encoded address.
Implicit caller address; any external account can invoke the Proxy fallback and thereby trigger an arbitrary delegatecall.
Inline-assembly delegatecall(gas, masterCopy, 0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) executed in the Proxy fallback, running master copy code with proxy storage in the caller context.
Inline-assembly call(gas, proxy, 0, add(data,0x20), mload(data), 0, 0) inside createProxy, forwarding user-supplied data to the freshly deployed proxy.
Inline-assembly create2(0x0, add(0x20, deploymentData), mload(deploymentData), salt) used for deterministic proxy deployment.
Inline-assembly call in createProxyWithNonce forwarding the initializer payload into the newly deployed proxy.
External call callback.proxyCreated(proxy, _mastercopy, initializer, saltNonce) executed after deployment, handing control to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.
Parameter _masterCopy of the Proxy constructor, the address of the master copy implementation.
Parameter masterCopy of ProxyFactory.createProxy, the implementation address for the new proxy.
Parameter data of ProxyFactory.createProxy, the payload forwarded to the new proxy via low-level call.
Parameter _mastercopy of deployProxyWithNonce, encoded into the deployment bytecode.
Parameter initializer of deployProxyWithNonce, hashed to derive the create2 salt.
Parameter saltNonce of deployProxyWithNonce, mixed into the create2 salt.
Parameter _mastercopy of createProxyWithNonce, forwarded to deployProxyWithNonce.
Parameter initializer of createProxyWithNonce, used both for the salt and as the call payload.
Parameter saltNonce of createProxyWithNonce, forwarded to deployProxyWithNonce.
Parameter _mastercopy of createProxyWithCallback, forwarded to createProxyWithNonce.
Parameter initializer of createProxyWithCallback, forwarded to createProxyWithNonce.
Parameter saltNonce of createProxyWithCallback, hashed together with the callback address.
Parameter callback of createProxyWithCallback, an arbitrary IProxyCreationCallback contract invoked after deployment.
Parameter _mastercopy of calculateCreateProxyWithNonceAddress.
Parameter initializer of calculateCreateProxyWithNonceAddress.
Parameter saltNonce of calculateCreateProxyWithNonceAddress.
Local bytes32 salt in deployProxyWithNonce computed as keccak256(abi.encodePacked(keccak256(initializer), saltNonce)).
Local bytes deploymentData in deployProxyWithNonce combining the proxy creation code and the master copy address.
Local uint256 saltNonceWithCallback in createProxyWithCallback derived from keccak256(saltNonce, callback).

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _masterCopy is validated and consumed by the Proxy constructor.
Constructor writes _masterCopy into the masterCopy state variable.
masterCopy slot value is read via sload(0) and used as the delegatecall target.
Any external caller (msg.sender) can invoke the fallback and cause the delegatecall with attacker-controlled calldata; there is no access control.
The fallback function unconditionally reaches the delegatecall assembly block.
masterCopy parameter of createProxy is passed into new Proxy(masterCopy).
data parameter of createProxy controls whether the follow-up call is executed.
User-supplied data payload is forwarded as calldata in the low-level call to the new proxy.
createProxy executes the inline-assembly call when data.length > 0.
_mastercopy parameter flows into deployProxyWithNonce.
initializer parameter flows into deployProxyWithNonce.
saltNonce parameter flows into deployProxyWithNonce.
initializer is hashed and incorporated into the local salt.
saltNonce is packed into the local salt.
_mastercopy is appended to the deployment bytecode.
Proxy creation code derived alongside the initializer-dependent salt is packed into deploymentData.
The derived salt is consumed by the create2 instruction.
deploymentData supplies the create2 init code and length.
_mastercopy parameter flows into createProxyWithNonce.
initializer parameter flows into createProxyWithNonce.
saltNonce parameter flows into createProxyWithNonce.
createProxyWithNonce calls deployProxyWithNonce and assigns the returned proxy.
initializer payload is forwarded in the low-level call to the new proxy.
createProxyWithNonce executes the inline-assembly call when initializer.length > 0.
_mastercopy parameter flows into createProxyWithCallback.
initializer parameter flows into createProxyWithCallback.
saltNonce parameter flows into createProxyWithCallback.
callback parameter flows into createProxyWithCallback.
saltNonce is hashed into saltNonceWithCallback.
The callback address is hashed into saltNonceWithCallback.
The callback-derived nonce is passed as saltNonce to createProxyWithNonce.
createProxyWithCallback calls createProxyWithNonce.
The caller-supplied callback address is the target of the external proxyCreated call.
After deployment the factory transfers control to an arbitrary external contract supplied by the caller.
proxyCreated gives the untrusted callback contract control flow that can re-enter the factory or the freshly created proxy before the transaction completes.
_mastercopy parameter flows into calculateCreateProxyWithNonceAddress.
initializer parameter flows into calculateCreateProxyWithNonceAddress.
saltNonce parameter flows into calculateCreateProxyWithNonceAddress.
calculateCreateProxyWithNonceAddress calls deployProxyWithNonce before reverting with the computed address.
